title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct) Fourth Amendment Directions, 2026 and related amendments for other regulated entities
description: <cite index="42-4,44-2">RBI issued nine circulars on 6 August 2026 to create a unified framework for loan recovery practices, each amending the Responsible Business Conduct framework for a different class of regulated entity</cite>. <cite index="43-3,43-4">The comprehensive framework governing loan recovery practices introduces stricter rules for recovery agents, enhanced borrower safeguards and tighter oversight of technology-based recovery mechanisms, effective from January 1, 2027</cite>.
